name: Uncommon App
detailed_description:
Welcome to Uncommon Academy!

In times such as these - full of post-conflict strife and upcoming uncertainty - being an admissions officer at Unmeiia's very own Uncommon Academy is a highly sought-after position. You should be proud. 
But keeping such a position won't be easy - an excellent officer is expected to balance the academic strength of the academy with its financial situation. Only the best students are admitted to Uncommon Academy, and only the best admissions officers don't lose their jobs.

Good luck!

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Application Review: Make tough choices as you evaluate diverse student profiles, balancing academic merit, magical ability, and financial viability.

  • Branching Consequences: Every decision affects your school's stats and storylines — who you admit today could reshape the campus tomorrow.

  • Mini Goals & Metrics: Follow shifting objectives and track real-time changes in your school’s Theory, Practice, and Finances.

  • Legendary Students: Unlock hidden applicants with powerful buffs (and surprising drawbacks) that influence future admissions rounds.

  • Interactive Interviews: Dive deeper into student personalities, personal histories, and magical vibes to make more informed — or emotional — decisions.

  • After-Hours Exploration: Meet students and staff across campus, uncover their secrets, and gather clues from a mysterious shop hidden nearby.
